title: Other reports still show negatives in brackets in their PDF
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging (preferred), or the Tiered Pricing QA site too once the release is deployed there; production is not needed.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use a staging location where Sales By Customer shows a negative Adjustments figure this month or last (as in the Today picture, for example (-$423.72)).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales By Customer.
  2. Download Sales By Customer's PDF.
  3. Download Sales By Customer's CSV.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales By Customer shows the negative figure in brackets, as today.

Step 2:

  • The PDF shows it in brackets with a $ (for example (-$423.72)), as today.

Step 3:

  • The CSV shows it as a plain number with a minus (for example -423.72), as today.
